svg.text: ECS r3 — SHEETS, DESIGN IMAGES AND MODEL: WHERE THEY DISAGREE, AND WHAT r3 DOES
'Sheet' = the ECS component sheets (rev R1, 25-05-18). 'Images' = the original ECS product images and their close-ups (source/design_refs). Measured on the r3 model.
Pin and channel are the same size
A4 pin Ø6.0 in the A2 channel 6.0: no running clearance; an open 6 × 4 channel cannot hold the pin.
8 mm slots in the spine bar, Ø6 stud with a Ø13.6 head on the strip side: 1 mm clearance per side, cannot pull out.
The A2 sheet's mounted view and the images put one rail on the spine. The images show a long tapered bar with three
slots, a disc boss and a top screw; the sheet says 142 with one channel.
Spine bar 20 → 18 × 5 (6061-T6) on a 2 mm tape over the A9 spine strip: slots S3 140–202, S2 214–272, S1 284–386, Ø37 disc boss at v 110,
Ø16 top screw at v 405, black tail tab. The A4 stud runs in S3 (54 mm travel); no function is claimed for S2 and S1.
The A1 sheet draws an X-shaped yoke; the images show pivot hubs on moulded side plates with slotted arms, a clevis and
Hubs Ø52 at w 39, v 398 on satin TPU side plates (shell + 6); slotted arm 235 × 18 × 5 (6 mm slot, offset to the front) in a plate pocket
with a guide pin; clevis 24 × 10 × 9 with a cross-pin takes the top-loop webbing; lifters run strap root → A1 lug.
The A4 sheet draws a pin, bracket and washer at the lumbar; the images show no lumbar hardware.
A4 hidden inside the lower spine strip: stud in S3, link, block + hinge pin, lumbar webbing to the wing roots.
A6 adjusts 80–260 mm; the images show no webbing beside the arms.
Hidden inside the shell and the back panel; hub → A4 stud needs 254 mm, inside the sheet range (6 mm below its top end).
A8 adjusts 200–210 mm (10 mm); the chest span between the strap centres is 189 mm on the S–M form.
Range to be widened (≈ 170–260 mm) to fit the sizes A7 covers.
No load body or strap sheets
The load volume and the padded straps appear only in the images (prototype spec ~260 × 480 × 180, ~22 L).
295 × 480 × 170 moulded shell, pads to w −36 (20.5 L outer); straps 58 → 42 wide, 12 → 9 thick, flat-wrapped binding, copper stitch lines,
load lifters, 25 mm tip ladder locks, then a V of two 20 mm legs onto the belt wing. All taken from the images.
Hardware summary: 6 ladder locks and 'GF nylon pivot pins'; the component sheets call for ≥ 10 ladder locks and a
r3 counts (worn model): 6 ladder locks, 2 buckles, 1 stainless pin + 1 stud, 2 hubs, 2 arm guide pins; the product pose adds a 38 mm ladder
A2 28 g; A7 hip belt 109 g; A4 22 g; A9 110 g.
Volume × density: A2 67 g as drawn, 70 g as imaged; A7 ≈ 134 g; A4 (hidden block, link, pin, stud) ≈ 26 g; A9 ≈ 299 g. The weight table
100–150 mm drop, 60–100 mm inward, −30–40 % moment arm.
Measured 11.6 mm slide, 0 mm inward and −1.9 % hip–COM distance at a 35° lean (sheet 2). The targets are not met.
• Load and fatigue tests of the A4 pin and stud, the spine bar, the hubs, the clevis and the bartacks (the 1.5–2.5 kN ratings are sheet values, not tested).
• A drop of ~100 mm would need a different principle (e.g. a 2:1 sheave or a cam at the low pivot); the front-run routing measures 30–37 mm.
• r3 is built to the original product images and their close-ups. Where the images disagree with each other, the hero image is the master reference: the side and back views put the hub
higher, show one strap leg instead of a V and show no top handle. r3 follows the hero; this is a reading of the images, not a claim of exactness. Sizing is S–M only.
• The worn model simplifies the belt (16 mm wings, no 38 mm ladder lock, no stitched panel); the product pose carries the 18 mm wings, the belt ladder lock and the panel.
• Textile patterns, seam allowances and the moulded TPU side plates are drawn as volumes and finishes, not patterns or tooling.
Unintended interference, upright / riding / product (rigid + soft parts vs form; product: soft vs rigid)
rigid > 0.3 mm; soft > 3 mm into the form, > 1 mm into rigid
A5 stabiliser loop span, upright / riding
A6 tension strap, hub → A4 stud
A7 belt circumference on the S–M form
Mass estimates use stated densities (6061 2.70, HDPE 0.95, GF nylon 1.35, acetal 1.41, steel 7.9, closed-cell foam 0.07 g/cm³, 500D 230 g/m², spacer mesh 300 g/m²): estimates, not weighed parts.
